name: Herodion
title: Paul's relative in Rome
summary: Herodion was a Christian in Rome whom Paul refers to as his relative. He is mentioned in the greetings of Romans as part of the early Christian community in the capital.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends a greeting to Herodion in his letter to the Romans and calls him his relative, suggesting that he was a Jewish Christian.

keyEvents.title: Part of the church in Rome
keyEvents.description: Herodion was part of the growing Christian community in Rome before Paul himself arrived there, and contributed to the spread of the gospel in the capital of the empire.
